1.title: Man Killed by Truck After ICE Encounter in Florida Was Visiting From Mexico
1.summary: A Central Florida nonprofit group identified the man as Juan Jairo Coronilla Durán and said he had planned to return home to his family.

2.title: Politicians Are Trying to Change What Chatbots Say About Them
2.summary: Political campaigns have something new to worry about these days: unflattering or incomplete information produced by A.I. programs when voters ask questions about candidates.

3.title: In Maine, Bellows Ends Senate Bid, as Jackson Builds Momentum
3.summary: The Maine secretary of state ended her run in a crowded race to replace Graham Platner as the Democratic Senate nominee.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Edge Closer to Wider War After U.S. Soldiers Killed
4.summary: The United States was said to be sending more warplanes to the Middle East, a move that was already in the works before Iranian fire killed two soldiers in Jordan.

5.title: Ferry carrying 133 passengers and crew sinks off Guyana coast
5.summary: Fifteen children are among 67 people rescued, officials say, with dozens still missing.

6.title: Russia Batters Kyiv in One of the Largest Missile Assaults of the War
6.summary: On Saturday, Ukraine hit two warehouses in Russia in strikes that killed at least eight people and injured 62.
